adrian_cole.name: Adrian Cole
adrian_cole.intro: Hi, I'm Adrian, your practical communication coach. We'll turn everyday ideas into clear, confident conversations, one useful step at a time.
adrian_cole.description: Transformez les idées du quotidien en une communication claire et assurée.

nora_hayes.name: Nora Hayes
nora_hayes.intro: Hi, I'm Nora. I'll help you build a learning routine that feels clear, manageable, and rewarding. Let's make steady progress together.
nora_hayes.description: Créez une routine facile à suivre pour progresser régulièrement.

maya_brooks.name: Maya Brooks
maya_brooks.role: Coach de pratique en situation réelle
maya_brooks.intro: Hi, I'm Maya! We'll use lively, real-world practice to help you communicate more naturally and enjoy every conversation.
maya_brooks.description: Entraînez-vous dans des situations concrètes pour communiquer naturellement et rester motivé.

clara_bennett.name: Clara Bennett
clara_bennett.intro: Hi, I'm Clara. I'll make language learning feel organized, approachable, and useful, so you can communicate with confidence every day.
clara_bennett.description: Rendez l'apprentissage des langues organisé, accessible et utile au quotidien.
